item.case_name: Text on screen in a clip
item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Mountain Morning Opening Title

turns.text: Make a silent 6-second widescreen clip. Start with a dark green title card saying exactly “A quieter kind of morning” in cream lettering for 2 seconds, then cut to a slow moving shot of a misty mountain lake at sunrise. No other text.

item.tests: Checks exact, legible title-card text, its opening placement and duration, and the transition into moving scenery.

answer_sheet.Title wording: A quieter kind of morning — exactly this capitalization, without quotation marks.
answer_sheet.Title styling and timing: Cream lettering on a dark green title card for the first 2 seconds; font and layout are your call.
answer_sheet.Scene after the title: A slow moving shot of a misty mountain lake at sunrise.

must_haves: The opening title reads exactly 'A quieter kind of morning', with no quotation marks or extra text.
The title is legible cream lettering on a dark green card, fully inside the frame.
The title card occupies approximately the first 2 seconds, then cuts to the lake scene.
The remaining scene shows a misty mountain lake at sunrise with visible slow camera or scene motion.
The delivered video is silent, 16:9 and approximately 6 seconds long.

turns.text: Make a silent 6-second widescreen clip. Start with a dark green title card saying exactly “A quieter kind of morning” in cream lettering for 2 seconds, then cut to a slow moving shot of a misty mountain lake at sunrise. No other text. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**Your requested 6-second clip would cost 96 credits** at free-plan **480p, widescreen 16:9**:

| Part | Duration | Credits |
|---|---:|---:|
| Dark green title card, exact cream lettering | 2 seconds | 0 |
| Slowly moving misty mountain lake at sunrise | 4 seconds | 96 |
| Joining the clips, with no sound | — | 0 |

The title card would be drawn rather than AI-generated, keeping **“A quieter kind of morning”** exact. No other text would be added.

**Cheaper options:**
- **72 credits:** 5 seconds total—2-second title + 3-second lake shot.
- **48 credits:** 4 seconds total—2-second title + 2-second lake shot.
- **Keep all 6 seconds for 48 credits:** generate only 2 seconds of lake footage and slow it to fill 4 seconds. This would require a separate editing step.
- **Smaller:** 480p is the lowest resolution supported by this production workflow; reducing the width or height afterward would not reduce generation costs.

I’ve only checked the plan; **nothing has been generated and no credits have been spent**. Which option would you like?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that—keep all 6 seconds for 48 credits by slowing the 2-second lake footage to fill 4 seconds.

dialog.agent:
I need to correct my earlier offer: the connected tools don’t include a playback-speed control, so I can’t assemble that 6-second version for 48 credits here. Sorry—I shouldn’t have offered it as directly executable.

**No credits have been spent.** The options are:
- **48 credits:** generate the 2-second lake shot, then slow it to 4 seconds in an external editor and add the free 2-second title card.
- **96 credits:** make the complete 6-second clip here.

Would you like me to generate **only the 2-second lake shot for 48 credits** for external editing?
Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?
dialog.user: No words on the lake shot. The separate title card should say exactly “A quieter kind of morning” in cream lettering on dark green for the first 2 seconds.

turns.agent:
The generation was refused because your account has **insufficient credits** for the 48-credit lake shot. **Nothing was generated and no credits were spent.**

You’d need enough credits to cover that cost before retrying. The separate title card and slowing the footage would still need to be done in an external editor.
